description.narrative: Jordan - Water Network Restructuring And Rehabilitation - Infrastructure Investment Activity: The Activity is designed to restructure and rehabilitate transmission and distribution water supply systems in key areas of Zarqa Governorate. In addition to reducing physical leaks, this Activity is designed to facilitate the transition of the water supply systems from periodic distribution under high pressure to more frequent, gravity-fed distribution. The Infrastructure Investment Activity consists of the following three sub-activities: Strategic Infrastructure Works (designed to install up to 65 system meters at up to 32 locations, and conduct condition assessments of the system through mapping and geographic information systems ("GIS")), Zarqa Water Supply Area ("WSA") Works (designed to rehabilitate, restructure, and upgrade works in the primary, secondary and tertiary water supply systems in the Zarqa WSA), and the Ruseifa WSA Works (designed to rehabilitate, restructure, and upgrade works in the water systems in the Ruseifa WSA).
Muhafazat az Zarqa'
